Changelog

Unreleased

  • Filings after librotenado 0007: the advance VAT return and the Anlage EÜR prepared from the books – again as a correction once one was submitted, outdated when the books change –, submitted through the adapter of their country, also as a test, and asked about; what the authority returns becomes a document. In the terminal, the web app, the API and with spezado filing and spezado adapter. There is no adapter for ELSTER yet (OPEN).
  • A container image for servers with every release, ghcr.io/spezado/spezado for Linux on amd64 and arm64: it runs the relay unless told otherwise; deploy/compose.yaml starts one behind a reverse proxy.
  • Data follows librotenado 0.7.2.

0.3.0 – 2026-10-29

spezado in the menu bar, and for apps that install it themselves. Still a preview – the German mappings are drafts until tax advisers have reviewed them.

  • spezado tray: the server with an icon in the menu bar (macOS) or the system tray (Windows) – open the web app, pair a device, start at login, quit. Built into the releases for macOS and Windows; Linux keeps serve without GTK.
  • spezado autostart on|off: starts spezado at login – a launch agent on macOS, the Run key on Windows, an XDG autostart entry on Linux.
  • For apps that start spezado themselves: serve and tray create the workspace if there is none and take the pairing code from SPEZADO_PAIRING_CODE (at least 16 letters, digits, - or _) – in the environment rather than on the command line, where others on the device could read it.

0.2.0 – 2026-10-29

Books on several devices, and shared with other people: synchronised through a relay, end-to-end encrypted. Still a preview – the German mappings are drafts until tax advisers have reviewed them. Data follows librotenado 0.6.

  • Synchronisation between a person’s own devices through a relay, end-to-end encrypted after librotenado 0006: spezado relay; starting it for books with a recovery code, inviting another device, joining, recovering; spezado sync, y and v in the terminal, the panel on the web app’s overview, and every minute while spezado serve runs.
  • Sharing books with other people – read, write or manage, set by the invitation –, removing a device or a person (the key of the books changes), and books a device may only read refuse to book.
  • The keys of synchronised books in the key store of the system, else in the workspace.
  • The seller’s details, customers and invoice numbers in the books: they travel with them, and every device writes its own series of numbers (RE-2026-B001).
  • Other devices reach spezado serve --listen over TLS, with a certificate of the workspace’s own whose fingerprint the pairing link carries, also as a QR code.
  • Licences: the description of the API (api/openapi.json) is MIT, so that clients generated from it can be licensed freely. The brand kit moved to its own repository, spezado/brand; brand/ keeps copies of what spezado uses, the artwork under CC BY-ND 4.0, Domitian under OFL-1.1.

0.1.0 – 2026-10-29

The first release, a preview: a freelancer’s year in the terminal and in the web app, in German and English. Not for a real tax return yet – the German mappings (VAT return, Anlage EÜR, SKR 03/04) are drafts until tax advisers have reviewed them. Data follows librotenado 0.4.1.

  • Books for a person: cash basis or double entry, standard VAT or small business, SKR 03 or 04, the state whose public holidays move deadlines and the permanent extension of VAT returns – both can be changed from a date on; opening balances.
  • Booking from a gross amount and a tax code or in lines; reversals; the journal, balances and ledgers.
  • Bank statements read from camt.053, MT940 and CSV files, a bank account per IBAN, entries booked by hand or by a proposal – the payment booked before the statement came, the invoice it pays, or as the same party’s last entry.
  • Documents: e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD) read into booking proposals, other documents filed; the originals kept by their hash.
  • Invoices written as XRechnung 3.0 or as ZUGFeRD – a PDF/A-3 with the XRechnung attached – with the seller’s details, customers and numbers in sequence – with VAT, exempt, under reverse charge (§ 13b UStG, services to businesses in other EU countries), intra-Community supplies, exports, or as a small business.
  • Reports: the advance VAT returns with their deadlines, the Anlage EÜR 2025 and 2026, the HGB statements; CSV.
  • Review list in words, closing periods, the GoBD data transfer (Z3).
  • Interfaces: the terminal (keyboard and mouse), the command line, the open API (spezado serve, OpenAPI, Server-Sent Events, pairing per device) and the web app it serves.
